question: In India, Gir forest is the last remaining habitat of which animal?
solution:
The correct answer is __Asiatic lion.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Gir forest in Gujarat has the Asiatic Lion.

 
• There are approximately 600 Asiatic lions left in the Gir Forest of Western India,
 
• It is their last remaining natural habitat.
 
• This small population of Asiatic lion lives in a tiny patch of forest where one disease epidemic or forest fire could wipe them out forever. &
